boundaries.conclusion: Optional placements_version=1 is separate from every prior capability. Three exact operation schemas append ADD/COPY or remove one existing placement. Unknown fields, maps, identities, coordinates, source syntax and domain budgets fail closed.

Caller allocates one placement/complete actor/group UUID set per add/copy intent. New generated identity values are mutually fresh against existing placements/actors/groups; helper additionally rejects its scene UUID. Referenced objectId definitions remain reusable and are not treated as generated identities.

Rust first expands original content and apply_edits expands final content within 128 KiB/128 placement and generated actor/group limits. Copy uses the original CST item span and replaces only identity value tokens. Remove cannot delete the last placement. No declaration, offset, override or shared fragment normalization is permitted by these actions.

Source, full original preview and complete proposal are detached before awaits. Factory binds actor/group provenance and source ownership using original source; prepare recomputes canonical edit, source revision, full ordered target receipt, exact afterContent and changedPaths. Workflow separately binds scene/path/session/token and releases every temporary candidate receipt.

ADD/COPY/REMOVE use complete expanded candidate identity/provenance validation, including sceneStructure.groups and sourceLocations.groups. Removing the selected opener is allowed. Full preview validates newly consumed projection/media dependencies; unused raw declarations alone do not promise effective rendering.

The UI owns one operation allocation and raw form signature. Changing inputs expires approval. Apply writes only the owned ordinary source draft; Save retains its baseline conflict preconditions and exact reviewed BOM/CRLF. Text authoring and five previous composition editors remain usable when the new capability is missing or unsupported.

The new pure/core slice has no filesystem or process/tool ports. Browser recipe preview is source-owned and remains non-executable; no build job was created and original backend generator/runtime files remain unchanged.

faultInjections: One valid HTTP response has its last sourceLocations.groups entry removed before delivery.
A real HTTP response is held, then its child is forcibly closed and the parent preview is closed; an actual visible source edit changes ownership before response delivery.
Capability phases wrap only the new WASM capability export at page boot; every other export and all HTTP/DOM controllers remain real.
flowAssertions: An unused fragment becomes a first placement with explicit fresh maps; its previously unconsumed projection image is checked by real complete preview, missing bytes reject approval, and Cancel preserves all author files.

ADD keeps one UUID allocation during raw input changes, repeated review and three 390px languages; projection, image, nested identity provenance and offset are complete. Silent unreviewed input is refused; Apply changes memory and ordinary Save preserves BOM/CRLF.

COPY appends two full nested-group placements with fresh complete maps, retaining every six-field local override, absent versus explicit-zero offset, escaped keys and exponent tokens byte-for-byte except identity values. A deliberately corrupted group provenance receipt is rejected, then retry succeeds and saved reopen retains identities.

REMOVE may remove the placement containing the selected opener. Complete actor/group mappings and local overrides disappear together; shared raw fragments and every other placement span remain unchanged. Cancel and ordinary Save/reopen both retain their proper source state.

A held real candidate arriving after dialog and source ownership change never reopens or replaces the new visible draft and is released by the HTTP host; this is an explicit asynchronous fault injection.
The last remaining placement cannot be removed; the independent one-placement recipe stays byte-identical.

With only the new WASM capability absent or unsupported, the placement-structure entry is disabled while five previous recipe editors still open and cancel through their real helpers; no author or backend build writes occur.

Ordinary Save detects a concurrent external recipe write and preserves both the reviewed local draft and exact external disk bytes. Original OC, projections, media, metadata and independent last-placement fixture stay untouched.

Complete candidate source, every identity/provenance and raw preservation are independently asserted from actual DOM/HTTP.
